name: soop
description: A language-agnostic project scaffolder driven by Lua templates. Soop bootstraps projects across different stacks, with heavy use of mise for toolchain versions, dependencies, and repeatable project setup.

name: lazyscripts
description: A collection of standalone Lua command-line tools, each focused on one small job and designed to live directly in your PATH. Install the collection, then choose the scripts you want to keep available.

scripts.name: todo
scripts.description: A Markdown-backed task tracker with add, list, status, and update commands. Tasks stay as readable files in a local todos directory.

scripts.name: jp
scripts.description: A fuzzy recipe picker for just, with optional Zellij floating-pane support for running the selected recipe.

scripts.name: zf
scripts.description: Runs any command inside a Zellij floating pane, keeping output visible until you dismiss it.

scripts.name: fancynames
scripts.description: Generates memorable adjective-animal names and unique email addresses for test data, mock users, and placeholder accounts.

name: lasyd
description: A Lua-powered service manager that gives macOS launchd and Linux systemd a shared configuration language.
